stories.title: Downeaster adds seats for Thanksgiving rush
stories.summary: More than 12,000 riders are expected Thanksgiving week, and many trains could sell out. The Downeaster will run four of its usual five round trips on Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Old Orchard Beach man charged with stalking after window reports
stories.summary: Police arrested Marc Paradis, 67, after two reports a week apart involving a home on Temple Avenue.

stories.title: Escaped New Hampshire inmate found at Scarborough hotel
stories.summary: Shawn Tarr escaped the Transitional Work Center in Concord, N.H., on Oct. 23. Scarborough police found and arrested him exactly one month later.

stories.title: Brewer discusses data center regulations ahead of decision
stories.summary: The city is holding an informational meeting on Tuesday at 6 p.m. in the Brewer Auditorium to discuss proposed regulations for data center projects.

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Colder weather settles in for Thanksgiving week. Another rain storm arrives Thursday night and into Friday.

stories.title: Non-stop flights between Maine and Bermuda coming in 2027
stories.summary: BermudAir plans to launch nonstop seasonal service between Portland and Hamilton, Bermuda beginning May 8, 2027

stories.title: Lisbon police ask for help in gunfire investigation
stories.summary: Police received a report of gunshots fired Monday night and are asking locals to check their security footage.

stories.title: Woolwich closes both Route 1 lanes after crash
stories.summary: Officials are asking people to avoid Route 1 in Woolwich as crews respond to a crash.

stories.title: South Portland school board rejects plan to change school district
stories.summary: At a school board meeting on Monday, members decided more time was needed to reconsider reconfiguration.

stories.title: Portland Harbor's $26M dredge project enters final stage
stories.summary: The multiyear dredging project is entering its final push as the city works to restore better access to its working waterfront

stories.title: York County Food Hub fills critical pantry gaps as holiday season approaches
stories.summary: The new facility distributed more than 30,000 pounds of food in its first month and is now helping local organizations prep Thanksgiving meal kits.

stories.title: Teenager dies after canoe overturns in Moosehead Lake
stories.summary: A 17-year-old has died after his canoe overturned in Moosehead Lake while paddling with friends on Saturday. His body was recovered on Sunday.
